checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: extract Motter 2024 expectancy trial and add a fifth linked claim boundary on the Evidence screen

impact_assessment.why: The review's measurement plan includes expectancy, but no corpus record shows whether baseline expectancy predicts training response; Motter 2024 is a 107-patient RCT with 78-week follow-up.
impact_assessment.benefits: Adds a direct null result for expectancy as a responder predictor and makes that boundary explicit alongside the other four.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: one context record + fifth list item + citation test; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: counts and references must move together
impact_assessment.mitigation: Verify via PubMed efetch, update counts/references/prose, add the linked bullet, run all suites and review the UI.
